input.query: Find the restaurant 'Bella Italia' on Google Maps, check its reviews, then get directions from my current location
input.perception: LAYOUT: Google Maps with search bar, map canvas, and sidebar. STATE: Map centered on current city, no location selected. CONTENT: [1] input#searchboxinput placeholder='Search Google Maps', [2] button#searchbox-searchbutton, [3] button "Directions". BLOCKERS: None. SPATIAL: Search bar top-left, map fills viewport, sidebar collapsed.

subtasks: Search for 'Bella Italia' in the Google Maps search bar
Click on the restaurant result and read the reviews section
Click 'Directions' and verify the route is displayed from current location

steps.objective: Search for 'Bella Italia' restaurant in the Maps search bar

verifyAfter.trigger: Restaurant card visible with rating and reviews count

steps.objective: Open the restaurant listing and read the reviews section
steps.successCriteria: Reviews section is visible with user ratings and review text

verifyAfter.trigger: Reviews tab or section with star ratings visible

steps.objective: Click 'Directions' to get a route from the current location to the restaurant
steps.successCriteria: Directions panel shows route with estimated travel time

verifyAfter.trigger: Route displayed on map with time/distance estimate
